lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good morning Priya! Thanks for picking up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Better than last week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's great to hear.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I need this for my head too, not just my body. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Frozen vegetables count just as much as fresh, and they're cheaper.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Does your family eat salad?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the vegetables going forward?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Beans count too, and they keep you full.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, my family eats late, like at 9, and I'm not going to eat alone. I didn't think I'd like it, but I do.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the vegetables going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It feels like a lot right now.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Being around for my family is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've tried before and it didn't stick.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Next week I want you to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 6.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 6 and not a 3?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If it rains I'll walk in the hallway of my building.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, so your plan this week is to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 3 days. Did I get that right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Priya, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

flags.reason: 'I don't really see the point' may signal hopelessness or low mood; coach moved on without asking how she is doing. Clarify today.
Coach set a specific goal ('Next week I want you to...') right after saying it was her plan, without asking permission or collaborating.
Line 13 ('I need this for my head too') was not explored; coach asked a closed question about the daughter.
Line 19 (wants to keep up with grandkids) was met with a closed question about salad instead of exploring the goal.
Verbatim repeat of line 26 right after a barrier was raised; did not address the late-meal barrier.
Verbatim repeat of line 37; participant was not invited to deepen the change talk.

score.summary: The coach gathered good change talk about family and confidence and closed with a clear plan, barrier check, summary and next contact. However, the coach repeated the same open questions verbatim, asked closed questions after change talk, and set the goal directly, so the participant's ownership and a possible low-mood cue were not explored.
strengths: Line 16 asked permission before sharing information, and line 43 stressed that the plan is hers.
Line 52 summarized the agreed plan and checked accuracy.
Line 50 asked about barriers, and line 54 set a midweek check-in.
coaching_tips: Line 39 repeats line 37 word for word; follow the change talk in line 38 with a reflection, e.g., 'Your granddaughter keeps you going.'
After line 13's change talk, reflect 'I need this for my head too' before asking about the daughter at line 14.
Line 40 ('I don't really see the point'): pause and ask directly about mood or hopefulness before returning to the plan.
Before line 44, ask permission or offer options, e.g., 'Would it be okay to suggest a next step?' to avoid persuading.
Line 31 repeats line 26 after a barrier; respond to the late-dinner barrier in line 30 first.
